ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Asymmetric distribution; left lobe exhibits a high-intensity white field with dark mottling along the trailing edge and proximal midline; right lobe is primarily low-intensity black with a localized high-intensity white patch on the distal lateral tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 52 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire continuous trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 3 to 12 pixels, appearing most jagged on the inner margins of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave trailing edge trajectory leading to acute, upward-hooked tips (falate) on both distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark-on-white circular clusters located in the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe; high-contrast white-on-black speckling visible on the medial portion of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned linear disruptions; prominent vertical dark rake marks on the left lobe (white field) and intersecting horizontal/diagonal light-colored scratches on the right lobe (black field).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel rake marks (likely odontocete-induced) across both lobes; unique jagged indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe approximately 20% from the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme bilateral pigment asymmetry where the left lobe is predominantly white and the right lobe is predominantly black.
